articles.title: XRP beat bitcoin gains as CLARITY Act advanced, but a real bullrun still needs Congress
articles.snippet: The token jumped 5% after a Senate committee moved the market-structure bill forward, reviving hopes that legal clarity can pull deeper institutional money into XRP products.

articles.title: Hana Financial to acquire 6.55% stake in Upbit operator Dunamu for $668M
articles.snippet: The purchase makes Hana Financial the fourth-largest shareholder in Dunamu, following several crypto-related deals in the last two months, as it dives deeper into the digital assets sector.

articles.title: President Trump Discloses Coinbase, Robinhood and Bitcoin Mining Stock Trades
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump reported trades in crypto firms like Coinbase and Robinhood, among others, according to new ethics filings.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot Flashes Bankruptcy Warning as ATM Revenue Falls, Regulatory Scrutiny Grows
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot issued a “going concern” warning, signaling severe uncertainty over its ability to survive the next 12 months.

articles.title: Kraken to Migrate Wrapped Bitcoin Tech to Chainlink as LayerZero Exodus Expands
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Kraken is the latest firm to shift away from LayerZero tech following last month's $292 million Kelp DAO exploit.
